items.name: @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams
items.repackNote: agent-teams 在 0.2.x 上因 ctx.subagents.registerContinuableSetup 被退役（改 provider 模式）而在 apply 期抛 TypeError，整个插件不激活、8 个 agent_teams_* 工具全丢。本补丁改为存在性探测 + 降级：缺该钩子时成员模型选择的持久化/冷恢复降级，建队/任务 DAG/派活/消息/状态照常可用。

items.name: @smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager
items.repackNote: Settings panel gained a second, page-level scrollbar on the Skins section. Cause: the visually-hidden import file input (.orL4ja_fileInput) is position:absolute with no left/top and its container .orL4ja_backupActions is not positioned, so its containing block resolves all the way up to the settings dialog (JPxlLa_panel, position:relative, overflow:auto). The 1px input then lands below the panel and inflates the panel scrollHeight by 104px; scrolling the panel drags the whole nav rail out of view. Fix: give .orL4ja_backupActions position:relative so the input is contained by its own button row. Verified by three independent probes (hiding the input / adding relative to the options scroller / adding relative to the parent all drop the panel overflow 104px -> 0), and the hidden input still fires clicks so import keeps working. 另修：皮肤卡片高度参差 —— .orL4ja_skinTile 的 versionRow 可换行导致同一行卡片底部错位（112/134/114.5px 三种），视觉上互相压边。统一 tile min-height:132px 并让 versionRow 不换行+省略；实测 12 个 tile 高度全部一致、零裁字。

items.name: computer-user
items.repackNote: Expose Config on the default export (the loader unwraps to default, so a named export alone is dropped), mark its fields volatile, and swap the retired settingsScope inject for a dual-generation configForms probe. Upstream 0.3.7 is maintained but targets the 0.1.3 kernel; drop these patches once it ships a 0.2.x release.
